buyer: Maintainer of the AGI ALPHA native Python agent
observed_need: Native requirements-agent.lock defines a real FastAPI/Starlette/Pydantic dependency tuple; changes require preserving the existing request-framing/security-header and strict-input-validation contracts. Prior source-only study did not resolve any consumer call.
demand: Observed internal software-maintenance need; proposed refresh is a research assessment, not an existing paid/customer bump ticket.
outcome: A bounded dependency-refresh decision for the actual public RequestBoundary and strict mission-input model: exact before/after environment locks, source-pinned requirement coverage, executable request/model observations, substantiated counterexamples or scoped preservation, a reviewable proposed lock change and explicit remaining release gates.
user_action: Use the packet to accept or reject this specific component-compatibility work package and select the next required full-application qualification. It does not authorize release or operator execution.
acceptance: The exact original public consumer source is exercised, with provenance for any isolation of pure definitions.
Published request framing, size, origin, timeout/disconnect and security header requirements retain independent expected outcomes.
Strict input type/bounds/unique-ID rejection and accepted mission serialization are checked against independent expected values.
A mismatch prevents compatibility acceptance and includes reproducible evidence. An unexecuted or unresolved required case makes the packet incomplete.
Claims are matched to source/lock/case/execution identities; independent verifier checks them and rejects unsubstantiated criticism.
Preparation, verification, correction, failures, packaging and remaining customer effort are recorded, without inventing money or demand.
excluded_authority: No create_app or Journal initialization, signing-key/token generation, network server, operator action, settlement or financial transaction.
No claim about authentication, whole-application mission execution or complete release readiness from isolated component checks.
permitted_execution: Existing local research Workbench adapter with inert source-bound probe worker; no expansion of native source admission.
freeze_status: Intent/discovery contract only; candidate, evaluator and confirmation protocol not yet frozen; no primary outcomes inspected.
governing_objective: Build an enterprise whose ability to create verified value grows through productive activity and whose retained economic resources can support increasingly ambitious capabilities.
investment_questions: Did the mission enable a useful decision or action?
Were complete delivery economics compelling against equivalent human work and strong practical tools?
What executable capability was created or improved?
Did fresh subsequent work repay complete incremental investment?
What productive capacity or available resources resulted?
Which next investment is justified, including adoption, maintenance, preserving reserves or stopping?

distinct_results.operational_benefit: Accepted outcome, resource, reliability or useful coverage improvement on fresh work.
distinct_results.economic_repayment: Supported incremental benefits exceed complete attributable incremental costs over justified work.
distinct_results.financeable_expansion: Actual collected proceeds leave resources after costs, obligations and reserves.
